contract.title: combination lock (4-press code)
contract.description: Build a combination lock with two buttons, L and R, and one lamp OPEN. The secret code is L, R, R, L. Every button press either continues the code (the lock advances one step) or cancels the attempt; a cancelled attempt restarts immediately when the press was L (the first symbol of the code), i.e. after a wrong press the lock is at step 1 if that press was L, else at step 0. After the fourth correct press in a row the lamp OPEN lights and stays lit until the next press (which cancels / restarts as above). The lamp is off at the start. Presses are at least 70 ticks apart; a press holds the button for 20 ticks. Library hint (component tier only): D flip-flop, AND, OR, delay line and crossover cells are available.
